title: Butternut Squash Casserole Recipe – Oma's Butternutkürbis-Auflauf.
ldName: Butternut Squash Casserole Recipe – Oma's Butternutkürbis-Auflauf
ldIngredientsRaw: ⅓ to ½ pound blue cheese, crumbled
ldInstructionsRaw: In a 9x12-inch baking dish, put butternut squash cubes on the bottom. Cover with whole cherry tomatoes. Cover that with red onion wedges.
Drizzle all over with olive oil.
Bake, uncovered, for about 30 minutes or until the squash is cooked.
Remove from oven. Sprinkle with crumbled blue cheese. Return to oven until cheese is melted, about 2 to 3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, as needed.
htmlIngredientLines: ⅓ to ½ pound blue cheese, crumbled
olive oil, salt, freshly ground black pepper
